link.title: Understanding the model
link.description: Ontology, taxonomy, knowledge graph and contextualization are the four terms that matter most in this platform, and the four most often used loosely. These pages explain each one in plain language, show how they relate, and take you from the idea to a model that describes your own operation. A plain-language primer on machine learning sits alongside them, because what a model can learn is decided by how well the operation is described.
